input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user, authority. The platform provides capabilities for user model details, jwt access denied handler, user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage authority records, so that I can track and organize authority data effectively.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to interact with person functionality, so that I can accomplish my person-related tasks.
